name: Megaturret Fix (PAL)
author: SavedbyBlood9
description: On the PAL disc, the Megaturret Glove's turrets bob on their stalks and never fire: PAL plays animations 1.2 times as fast for its 50 Hz, so a turret's unfold (and its fold, when too many are out) skips the frame it waits for and replays forever. The mod finishes a stuck unfold or fold the moment it starts over, the way the game would, and the turrets aim and fire their rockets as they do on NTSC-U.
